## Changes Made

### 🔒 Security Fixes

| File | Problem | Fix |
|------|---------|-----|
| [`WalletsView.swift`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/WalletsView.swift#L160-L165) | Recovery phrase remained visible in the iOS **app-switcher snapshot** when shown immediately after wallet creation | Removed the `initialMnemonic == nil` guard — phrase is now always cleared when the app leaves the foreground |
| [`KeychainVault.swift`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/KeychainVault.swift#L42-L51) | Intermediate `Data(mnemonic.utf8)` buffer stayed in process memory after `SecItemAdd` | Call `mnemonicData.resetBytes(in:)` immediately after saving to Keychain |
| [`Wei.swift`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/Wei.swift#L30-L39) | `multiply` accumulator used `[Int]` — would theoretically overflow on 32-bit targets | Changed to `[UInt64]` arithmetic throughout |

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

| File | Problem | Fix |
|------|---------|-----|
| [`SendView.swift`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/SendView.swift#L165-L179) | Receipt-polling `Task` kept running for ~2 minutes after the user closed the review sheet | Stored task in `@State receiptTask`; cancelled on sheet close |

### 📦 Project / App Store Fixes

| File | Problem | Fix |
|------|---------|-----|
| [`project.yml`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/project.yml) | `SWIFT_VERSION: "5.0"` — too old for modern concurrency | Bumped to `"5.9"` |
| [`project.yml`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/project.yml) | `PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy` was **excluded** from sources — it would not be bundled with the app | Added as an explicit `buildPhase: resources` entry |
| [`project.yml`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/project.yml) | Missing `ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption` — App Store **export compliance** requirement | Set to `false` |

## VaultETH — What's Next

### 🔴 Blockers (must-do before real funds)

These are the [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/SECURITY.md) release gates — none are skippable:

1. **CI must pass** — The GitHub Actions workflow builds and runs tests. It needs a Mac runner with Xcode + `xcodegen`. Check the [swift.yml](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/.github/workflows/swift.yml) workflow to confirm it's using a recent enough Xcode (needs 15+ for iOS 17 deployment target). The unit tests for signing, address derivation, and wei math should pass on first run since they use independently verified vectors.

2. **Physical device testing** — Simulator can't test Face ID or real Keychain. Needs:
   - Create → back up → delete → reinstall → import (verify same address)
   - Face ID and passcode-only device paths
   - A test mainnet send from a throwaway wallet

3. **Independent security review** — Especially the signing path ([`WalletEngine.sign`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/WalletEngine.swift#L95-L112)) and Keychain access control setup ([`KeychainVault`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/KeychainVault.swift))
